info.name: Boltz Compute Admin Small Molecule API

description.content:
Boltz Compute API - biomolecular structure & binding prediction, ADME prediction, and generative small-molecule and protein design as asynchronous compute jobs. Operation surface derived from the official Boltz SDKs (boltz-bio/boltz-api-go); request/response schemas are not published by Boltz and are intentionally left generic.

 Name: Boltz PBC
 Email: contact@boltz.bio
